setting.note: Middle-earth is invented, so this map holds only the documented real-world places Tolkien drew on: the West Midlands countryside of his Birmingham boyhood behind the Shire, the West Country hills and caves he lent to Rohan and Helm's Deep, and, far off the map, the alpine valley and the Great War battlefield that fed Rivendell and the Dead Marshes.

palette.note: The deep green of the Shire's fields and the West Midlands countryside Tolkien remembered. A cited book's colour is not a quotation; it still has to be legible, and this clears WCAG AA on paper.
